tickets.short_description: Fallout - number port-in for TN (972) 555-0111 stuck past its FOC date and not activated.
tickets.block:
2026-07-01 12:25:00 - Ayush Singh (Comments)
Subcategory: Number Porting
Port Request: LSR-556001
TN: (972) 555-0111
Service Type: Voice - Local Number Port
Resolution Code: Port Completed - LSR Resubmitted
Description:
Fallout - number port-in for TN (972) 555-0111 stuck past its FOC date and not activated.
Work Notes:
Auto-flagged by the porting fallout monitor. Awaiting agent disposition.
Resolution Notes:
The losing carrier rejected the LSR because the customer name and service address did not match the CSR on file. Order Management pulled a fresh CSR, corrected the details, and resubmitted the LSR. A new FOC date was issued and the number ported. No dispatch required. Service Agent confirmed the transfer to the customer.

tickets.short_description: Fallout - number port-in for TN (214) 555-0177 rejected by the losing carrier and not activated.

TN: (214) 555-0177
Service Type: Voice - Local Number Port
Resolution Code: Port Completed - Account Corrected
Description:
Fallout - number port-in for TN (214) 555-0177 rejected by the losing carrier and not activated.
Work Notes:
Auto-flagged by the porting fallout monitor. Awaiting agent disposition.
Resolution Notes:
The rejection reason was an incorrect account number and porting PIN on the LSR. Order Management obtained the correct account number and PIN from the customer, updated and resubmitted the port request. The carrier issued a FOC and the number ported. Service Assurance verified calling. Service Agent informed the customer the port completed.

tickets.short_description: Fallout - TN (469) 555-0102 lost service and the number is no longer active on our network.
tickets.block:
2026-07-01 12:26:01 - Ayush Singh (Comments)
Subcategory: Number Porting
Port Request: LSR-559120
TN: (469) 555-0102
Service Type: Voice - Local Number Port
Resolution Code: Port Recovered - Port-Out Rejected
Description:
Fallout - TN (469) 555-0102 lost service and the number is no longer active on our network.
Work Notes:
Auto-flagged by the porting fallout monitor. Awaiting agent disposition.
Resolution Notes:
The number had been ported out to another carrier without valid authorization. Order Management filed a port-out rejection/recovery (snap-back) with the winning carrier and recovered the number. Network Operations re-provisioned it on the original switch translations and Service Assurance confirmed the line was live. Service Agent confirmed restoration and advised adding a port-out PIN.
